name: Compare Cities
description: Put up to four cities side by side: today's weather, a 7-day temperature chart with one line each, and which one is warmest and driest.
prompt: A compare cities weather app using the free Open-Meteo API with no key. Let me search and add up to four cities and show them side by side: current temperature, feels like, sky icon, rain chance, wind and humidity, plus a 7 day chart with one coloured line per city for the max temperature. Highlight which city is warmest, sunniest and least rainy this week. Save my list of cities.
author: gonzaroman
